audit.whatIsWrong: Three facts were absent: the condition on Stretching Strikes, Unstable Matter's range and cadence, and Cell Division's five-minute revive.
audit.why: Riot on Stretching Strikes: 'Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other' — with no second target he cannot complete the throw. Riot on Unstable Matter: a 5-second, 350-range burst dealing 'a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage', so idling next to him is the real bleed. Riot on Cell Division: 'Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets... This ability has a 5 minute cooldown' — once it has fired, the next fight is a clean kill, and the blobs he sheds on every ability hit can be stood on to deny the heal.
audit.corrected: All three written into the phase whys, cooldown block, trading rules, dos/donts and interactions row.

I wrote nothing asserting grounding, which matters because a real grounding would deny Skip 'n Slash.
